item.title: Iranians Are Rejecting Theocracy: The Islamic Republic’s Unintended Legacy
item.description: In 1979, 98% of Iranians voted for an Islamic Republic. Forty-seven years later, mosques stand empty and protesters chant for the return of the Shah. How did a theocracy create one of history’s fastest religious declines? A data-driven look at faith, coercion, and unintended consequences.

item.title: A Skeptic’s Guide to Ozempic and Other GLP-1 Agonists
item.description: William Meller, MD, examines the GLP-1 drug phenomenon. Are these “miracle” weight loss drugs worth the hype, or just expensive lifetime prescriptions with serious trade-offs? The surprising science and sobering risks revealed.
